expectations.text: Warns that migrating an unlisted app with more than 25 installs enforces the 25-install cap
expectations.evidence: "Migrating an unlisted app enforces the 25-install cap†, and you have about 115 installs above it."

expectations.text: Says to contact HubSpot (support request, technology partner team or partner manager) before running the migration
expectations.evidence: "Open a support request, or write to your Technology Partner Manager" and "Do not run `hs app migrate` until you have their answer in writing."

expectations.text: Does not recommend listing the app as-is on the legacy architecture

expectations.text: States that classic CRM cards block new listings and must be converted to app cards
expectations.evidence: "Classic CRM cards can't list either. They are banned for new listings†, so they must become app cards."

expectations.text: Puts listing after migration to the developer platform in the recommended sequence

expectations.text: Puts agent tools after the app is on the developer platform

expectations.text: States that agent tools need their own HubSpot review before a listed app can deploy them

expectations.text: Recommends migrating to a currently supported platform version rather than an older projects version
